scientific_choices.choice: Four manually selected actual TRAIN demonstrations, fixed before inference. Exclude their entire images and exact image-hash duplicates from evaluation. Not an untouched validation dataset.

ALL_WORDS receives every retained V1 OCR block/bbox, not raw CC or crop pixels. ONE_WORD is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY GT-box oracle grouping. Ground-truth transcripts only in demonstrations and evaluation/logging, not query prompts.

ONE_WORD sorts associated fragments along the GT bbox dominant axis. Every evaluation GT word, including zero-input cases, remains in denominator. Multiword/ambiguous crops are recorded and assigned once, never split using GT text.

ALL_WORDS evaluated by per-image casefold one-to-one lexical matching, not spatial recognition accuracy; fuzzy uses maximum-cardinality matching at0.8. ONE_WORD direct per-word exact/fuzzy. Report metrics separately.
Qualified Qwen1.5B BF16, standalone GPU batch1 on PAPER. No new model, weights, segmentation, OCR or caption generation.
